name: TimeBucks
description: Large GPT platform with a dedicated 'Earn while you watch' system for curated YouTube viewing sessions. Also offers surveys, offers, tasks and content rewards. Cash payouts via PayPal, Skrill, AirTM and crypto. Note: video availability depends on your country and current advertising inventory.

name: HideoutTV
description: Dedicated watch-to-earn platform. Users earn points from advertisements while watching curated video content. Points can be redeemed directly or transferred into Lootup points for cash withdrawal. One of the cleanest watch-to-earn models available — actual video rewards, not a GPT add-on.

name: Lootup
description: GPT platform with HideoutTV integration for watch-to-earn. Earn points through videos, surveys, offers and tasks. Points redeemable for cash and rewards. HideoutTV points can be transferred into Lootup at a fixed rate.

name: Nielsen
description: Passive media measurement platform. Nielsen pays users to allow measurement of their normal TV, streaming and internet usage. Different model from watch-to-earn — you don't watch anything special, you just let Nielsen track what you already watch. Points and rewards based on participation.

name: InboxDollars
description: US-only rewards platform with videos/TV content alongside surveys, offers and paid emails. Video availability explicitly depends on location, account activity and advertiser availability. Payments via PayPal, prepaid card or check.

name: PrizeRebel
description: GPT platform with partner video/offer integrations alongside surveys and offers. Trustpilot 3.7/5 from 785 reviews. Rewards via PayPal, gift cards and crypto.

name: GrabPoints
description: GPT platform with videos through partner inventory alongside app offers, games and surveys. Rewards via PayPal and gift cards. Available in many countries including the UK.

name: Freecash
description: Large GPT platform with some video-related offer tasks alongside app installs, game offers, surveys and cashback. Trustpilot 4.6/5. Note: not a pure watch-to-earn platform — video is one of many earning methods.
